content: चारः [चर एव अण्] .²1 Going, walking, gait, wandering about; मण्डलचारशीघ्रः <ls>V. 5. 2</ls>; क्रीडाशैले यदि च विचरेत् पादचारेण गौरी <ls>Me. 60</ls>; निवृत्तचारः सहसा गतो रविः प्रवृत्तचारा रजनी ह्युपस्थिता <ls>Rām. 2. 66. 26</ls> walk on foot. .²2 Motion, course, progression; मङ्गलचार, शनिचार, राहु˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 A spy, scout, secret emissary; <ls>Ms. 7. 184</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 261</ls>; see चारचक्षुस् below. .²4 Performing, practising. .²5 A prison. .²6 A bond, fetter. .²7 The Pippalī tree or the Priyāla tree. .²8 A platform, <ls>Māna. 62. 1. 3</ls>. .{@-रम्@} An artificial poison.
